Physical Demands and  Job Conditions:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.  Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Role is deemed safety-sensitive and may be subject to employer or customer drug testing.

 

General Physical Requirements:

  • Exerting up to 50 pounds of force occasionally and/or up to 20 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects.

Physical Activities:

  • Ascending or descending ladders, stairs, scaffolding, ramps, poles and the like, using feet and legs and/or hands and arms. Body agility is emphasized.
  • Maintaining body equilibrium to prevent falling when walking, standing, or crouching on narrow, slippery, or erratically moving surfaces.
  • Bending body downward and forward by bending spine at the waist. This factor is important if it occurs to a considerable degree and requires full use of the lower extremities and back muscles.
  • Bending legs at knee to come to a rest on knees.
  • Bending the body downward and forward by bending leg and spine.
  • Moving about on hands and knees or hands and feet.
  • Extending hand(s) and arm(s) in any direction.
  • Moving about on foot to accomplish tasks, particularly for long distances or moving from one work site to another.
  • Using upper extremities to press against something with steady force in order to thrust forward, downward, or outward.
  • Using upper extremities to exert force in order to draw, drag, haul, or tug objects in a sustained motion.
  • Raising objects from a lower to a higher position or moving objects horizontally from position to position.
  • Picking, pinching, typing, or otherwise working, primarily with fingers rather than the whole hand or arm as in handling.
  • Applying pressure to an object with the fingers and palm.
  • Perceiving attributes of objects, such as size, shape, temperature, or texture by touching with skin, particularly that of fingertips.
  • Expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word.  Those activities in which they must convey detailed or important spoken instructions to customer or other workers accurately, loudly, or quickly.
  • Perceiving the nature of sounds at normal speaking levels with or without correction.  Ability to receive detailed information through oral communication, and to make the discriminations in sound.
  • Substantial movement (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers to use a computer.

Visual Acuity

  • The employee is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as: visual inspection involving small defects, small parts and/or operation of machines (including inspection), using measurement devices, and/or assembly or fabrication of parts at distances close to the eyes.
  • The employee is required to have visual acuity to operate motor vehicles.
  • The employee is required to have visual acuity to determine the accuracy, neatness, thoroughness of work assigned or to make general observations of facilities or structures.

Working Conditions

  • Activities occur indoors and outdoors.
  • External temperatures above 100 degrees for periods of more than one hour.  Consideration should be given to the effect of other environmental conditions, such as wind and humidity.
  • Includes a variety of physical conditions, such as proximity to moving mechanical parts, moving vehicles, electrical current or exposure to chemicals.
  • Atmospheric conditions, one or more of the following conditions that affect the respiratory system or the skin:  fumes, odors, dust, mists, gases, or poor ventilation.
  • There is air and/or skin exposure to oils and other cutting fluids.

job.title: Business Development Manager
job.description:
About the Role


We are seeking an experienced Business Development Sales Engineer to drive growth and diversification of our advanced microelectronics and Multi-Chip Module (MCM) manufacturing business.

This position will focus on developing new customers, markets, and manufacturing programs, particularly within the aerospace, medical, defense, and other high-reliability electronics industries. The role combines technical knowledge with proactive business development, helping customers identify manufacturing solutions while expanding the use of our existing microelectronics, electronic assembly, and packaging capabilities into new markets.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of semiconductor packaging, MCM/SCM manufacturing, electronic assembly processes, automated manufacturing equipment, and high-reliability electronics, combined with a demonstrated ability to identify opportunities, develop customer relationships, and convert those opportunities into sustainable production revenue.


Responsibilities

  • Develop new business within aerospace, medical, defense, and other high-reliability electronics markets.
  • Identify and pursue prospective customers and manufacturing programs that align with our MCM, SCM, microelectronics, and electronics assembly capabilities.
  • Establish relationships with engineering, supply chain, procurement, program management, and other key customer decision makers.
  • Develop and maintain a qualified pipeline of new business opportunities.
  • Serve as the technical and commercial interface between customers and internal engineering, manufacturing, quality, and operations teams.
  • Understand customer technical, quality, qualification, volume, and commercial requirements and recommend appropriate solutions.
  • Prepare quotations, proposals, technical presentations, and commercial recommendations.
  • Lead customer opportunities from initial identification through RFQ, qualification, prototype, and production launch.
  • Support customer audits, site visits, qualification activities, and new-product introductions.
  • Work with engineering and operations to identify manufacturing or capability gaps required to address new market opportunities.
  • Maintain sales forecasts, opportunity pipelines, and customer activity records.
  • Monitor industry trends, competitive activity, emerging technologies, and potential target accounts.
  • Represent the company at customer visits, trade shows, technical conferences, and industry events.

Minimum Qualifications


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Electronics, Manufacturing Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or a related technical discipline.
  • An equivalent combination of relevant education and significant industry experience may be considered.

Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in technical sales, business development, applications engineering, manufacturing engineering, or product engineering within the semiconductor, microelectronics, electronics manufacturing, or advanced packaging industries.
  • Experience supporting customers utilizing Multi-Chip Modules (MCMs), Single-Chip Modules (SCMs), semiconductor packaging, hybrid microelectronics, or advanced electronic assemblies.
  • Working knowledge of silicon wafers, die attach, wire bonding, flip-chip, SMT processes, and related manufacturing technologies.
  • Experience with automated manufacturing technologies such as pick-and-place systems, wire bonding, assembly automation, and inspection platforms.
  • Demonstrated success developing new customer relationships, generating opportunities, and growing revenue.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 10+ years of relevant industry experience.
  • Business development or technical sales experience within aerospace, defense, medical devices, or high-reliability electronics.
  • Established relationships with OEMs, Tier 1/Tier 2 suppliers, or other organizations within targeted markets.
  • Knowledge of substrate technologies, hermetic packaging, reliability testing, traceability, and high-reliability manufacturing.
  • Familiarity with relevant quality and manufacturing standards such as AS9100, ISO 13485, ISO 9001, IPC J-STD-001, IPC-A-610, and MIL-STD-883, as applicable.
  • Experience using CRM and sales pipeline management tools.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong technical understanding of microelectronics manufacturing and packaging.
  • Strong prospecting and new-business development capabilities.
  • Ability to identify markets and applications where existing manufacturing capabilities provide a competitive advantage.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to translate customer requirements into practical technical and commercial solutions.
  • Strong negotiation and commercial skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with engineering, procurement, supply chain, and executive-level stakeholders.
  • Self-motivated and capable of independently developing new accounts and opportunities.
  • Strong organizational, pipeline-management, and project-management skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, operations, quality, finance, and sales organizations.

Travel

Travel is required to support customer development, customer meetings, site visits, trade shows, and other business development activities.
